title: Observed planet occurrence, multiplicity and spacing, with their sources (GEN.728, GEN.828, GEN.829, GEN.729, TEST.395)
note: Every number is one a paper prints. 'where' says what was read: the abstract (arXiv listing) or the full text (arXiv PDF). Label READ is a number read in the source named in 'source'; 2ND-HAND is a number read in a second paper that quotes the first, named in 'citing'. A band with a null 'minus' or 'plus' has no printed uncertainty: the reader widens it by 'default_relative_width'. Tier follows docs/design/research/stand-in-values.md (T1 read in the source and the value is the source's; T2 read second-hand or a rounded figure).
